-Air Handler
Installation
We start by
installing the new air
handler, reconfiguring the

damage. As part of this

-Condenser
Installation
The installation
of the condenser includes
reconfiguring the line set
to ensure optimal
refrigeration flow. We
clean the line set
thoroughly to remove any
contaminants and braze in
the new system to
establish secure and
durable connections. To
further enhance
performance, we
reinsulate the line set,
ensuring effective
operation and energy
efficiency.
-System
Enhancements and Final
Touches
A new T6
Honeywell thermostat is
installed to give you
precise control over your
system, improving comfort
and energy efficiency. We
also pull a vacuum to a
minimum of 500 microns
to eliminate moisture and
air from the system,
ensuring smooth
operation. To provide
added security and
longevity, tamper-
resistant locking caps are
installed on the refrigerant
lines, and new Hurricane
straps are added to
protect the condenser
against extreme weather
conditions. Once the
installation is complete,
we perform a
comprehensive test of the
entire system to ensure it
operates smoothly,
efficiently, and reliably,
delivering long-term
comfort for your home or
business. This all-inclusive
service guarantees your
new HVAC system will
provide optimal
performance, safety, and
efficiency for years to
come.

lineItems.name: Dual Capacitor Reg Primary
lineItems.description:
A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary
phase shift and stored
electrical energy to help
both the compressor and
condenser fan motor start
and operate efficiently. By
maintaining proper motor
performance, the capacitor
improves system efficiency,
reduces electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system.
A weak or failed capacitor
can result in hard starting,
reduced cooling

lineItems.name: Surge Protector
lineItems.description:
HVAC systems rely on
sophisticated electronic
controls and variable-speed
components that are
vulnerable to voltage
transients caused by
lightning, utility
disturbances, and power
restoration events. A surge
protection device (SPD)
helps mitigate these voltage
spikes before they can
damage critical components
such as control boards,
motors, and compressors.
Installing surge protection

electrical component that

shift and stored electrical
energy to help both the
compressor and condenser
fan motor start and operate
efficiently. By maintaining
proper motor performance,
the capacitor improves
system efficiency, reduces
electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system. A
weak or failed capacitor can
result in hard starting,
reduced cooling performance,
increased energy
consumption, or complete
system failure.

Compressor
Replacement Service
Our expert technicians will
replace your condenser
compressor to restore your
HVAC system’s cooling
power and efficiency. The
process begins with safely
recovering the refrigerant
and disconnecting the
faulty compressor. We then
install a new, manufacturer-
approved compressor,
ensuring all electrical and
refrigerant connections are
secure. After reassembling
the system, we conduct a
thorough leak test, vacuum
the system, and recharge it
with the correct refrigerant.
Finally, we test the system
to ensure proper operation,
efficiency, and reliability, so
your home stays cool and
comfortable.

lineItems.description:
Our Full System Installation
Service begins with the
careful disposal of any old
equipment to clear space
for your new system. This
comprehensive service
includes the installation of
both the air handler and the
condenser, ensuring a
seamless and efficient
upgrade to your HVAC
system.
-Air Handler
Installation
We start by
installing the new air
handler, reconfiguring the
plumbing, and integrating
new float switches to
enhance safety and prevent
potential water damage. As
part of this process, we
reseal and rebuild the
plenum to optimize airflow
and eliminate air leaks,
maximizing your system’s

efficiency.
-Condenser
Installation
The installation
of the condenser includes
reconfiguring the line set to
ensure optimal refrigeration
flow. We clean the line set
thoroughly to remove any
contaminants and braze in
the new system to establish
secure and durable
connections. To further
enhance performance, we
reinsulate the line set,
ensuring effective operation
and energy efficiency.
System Enhancements and
Final Touches
A new T6
Honeywell thermostat is
installed to give you precise
control over your system,
improving comfort and
energy efficiency. We also
pull a vacuum to a
minimum of 500 microns to
eliminate moisture and air
from the system, ensuring
smooth operation. To
provide added security and
longevity, tamper-resistant
locking caps are installed on
the refrigerant lines, and
new Hurricane straps are
added to protect the
condenser against extreme
weather conditions. Once
the installation is complete,
we perform a
comprehensive test of the
entire system to ensure it
operates smoothly,
efficiently, and reliably,
delivering long-term
comfort for your home or
business. This all-inclusive
service guarantees your
new HVAC system will
provide optimal
performance, safety, and
efficiency for years to
come.

helps extend the life of your
system, improves efficiency,
and reduces the risk of
unexpected breakdowns.

Dual Capacitor Reg
A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary
phase shift and stored
electrical energy to help
both the compressor and
condenser fan motor start
and operate efficiently. By
maintaining proper motor
performance, the capacitor
improves system efficiency,
reduces electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system.
A weak or failed capacitor
can result in hard starting,
reduced cooling
performance, increased
energy consumption, or
complete system failure.

A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary
phase shift and stored
electrical energy to help
both the compressor and
condenser fan motor start
and operate efficiently. By
maintaining proper motor
performance, the capacitor
improves system efficiency,
reduces electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system.
A weak or failed capacitor
can result in hard starting,
reduced cooling
performance, increased
energy consumption, or
complete system failure.

lineItems.name: Full System Install Service
lineItems.description:
Our Full System Installation
Service begins with the
careful disposal of any old
equipment to clear space
for your new system. This
comprehensive service
includes the installation of
both the air handler and the
condenser, ensuring a
seamless and efficient
upgrade to your HVAC
system.
-Air Handler

lineItems.name: Presented
lineItems.description:
Overdue
Installation
We start by
installing the new air
handler, reconfiguring the
plumbing, and integrating
new float switches to
enhance safety and prevent
potential water damage. As
part of this process, we
reseal and rebuild the
plenum to optimize airflow
and eliminate air leaks,
maximizing your system’s
efficiency.
-Condenser
Installation
The installation
of the condenser includes
reconfiguring the line set to
ensure optimal refrigeration
flow. We clean the line set
thoroughly to remove any
contaminants and braze in
the new system to establish
secure and durable
connections. To further
enhance performance, we
reinsulate the line set,
ensuring effective operation
and energy efficiency.
System Enhancements and
Final Touches
A new T6
Honeywell thermostat is
installed to give you precise
control over your system,
improving comfort and
energy efficiency. We also
pull a vacuum to a
minimum of 500 microns to
eliminate moisture and air
from the system, ensuring
smooth operation. To
provide added security and
longevity, tamper-resistant
locking caps are installed on
the refrigerant lines, and
new Hurricane straps are
added to protect the
condenser against extreme
weather conditions. Once
the installation is complete,
we perform a
comprehensive test of the
entire system to ensure it
operates smoothly,
efficiently, and reliably,
delivering long-term
comfort for your home or
business. This all-inclusive
service guarantees your
new HVAC system will
provide optimal
performance, safety, and
efficiency for years to
come.
-Preventive
Maintenance Plan
To keep
your new HVAC system
running at peak
performance, we offer a
Preventive Maintenance
Plan. Regular maintenance
helps extend the life of your
system, improves efficiency,
and reduces the risk of
unexpected breakdowns.
(This plan is not included
please call our office for
more details on how to sign
up for this plan)

lineItems.name: Dual Capacitor Reg Primary
lineItems.description:
A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary
phase shift and stored
electrical energy to help
both the compressor and
condenser fan motor start
and operate efficiently. By
maintaining proper motor
performance, the capacitor
improves system efficiency,
reduces electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system.
A weak or failed capacitor
can result in hard starting,
reduced cooling
performance, increased
energy consumption, or
complete system failure.

Condenser Fan Motor
Replacement Service
Our professional technicians
will replace your condenser
fan motor to restore proper
airflow and prevent your
HVAC system from
overheating. We begin by
safely disconnecting power
and removing the faulty
motor. A new, high-quality
motor is installed, ensuring
proper wiring, mounting,
and fan blade alignment.
Once secured, we test the
system for proper airflow
and cooling efficiency.
Finally, we verify the
motor’s performance,
ensure smooth operation,
and clean up the work area,
leaving your system running
reliably and efficiently.

lineItems.name: Compressor Replacement Service
lineItems.description:
Our expert technicians will
replace your condenser
compressor to restore your
HVAC system’s cooling
power and efficiency. The
process begins with safely
recovering the refrigerant
and disconnecting the
faulty compressor. We then
install a new, manufacturer-
approved compressor,
ensuring all electrical and
refrigerant connections are
secure. After reassembling
the system, we conduct a
thorough leak test, vacuum
the system, and recharge it
with the correct refrigerant.
Finally, we test the system
to ensure proper operation,
efficiency, and reliability, so
your home stays cool and
comfortable.

lineItems.name: Dual Capacitor Reg
lineItems.description:
Additional
A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary
phase shift and stored
electrical energy to help
both the compressor and
condenser fan motor start
and operate efficiently. By
maintaining proper motor
performance, the capacitor
improves system efficiency,
reduces electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system.
A weak or failed capacitor
can result in hard starting,
reduced cooling
performance, increased
energy consumption, or
complete system failure.

lineItems.description:
Overdue
Robert

Condenser Fan Motor
Replacement Service
Our professional technicians
will replace your condenser
fan motor to restore proper
airflow and prevent your
HVAC system from
overheating. We begin by
safely disconnecting power
and removing the faulty
motor. A new, high-quality
motor is installed, ensuring
proper wiring, mounting,
and fan blade alignment.
Once secured, we test the
system for proper airflow
and cooling efficiency.
Finally, we verify the
motor’s performance,
ensure smooth operation,
and clean up the work area,
leaving your system running
reliably and efficiently.

lineItems.name: Dual Capacitor Reg Primary
lineItems.description:
A dual run capacitor is an
electrical component that
provides the necessary phase
shift and stored electrical
energy to help both the
compressor and condenser
fan motor start and operate
efficiently. By maintaining
proper motor performance,
the capacitor improves
system efficiency, reduces
electrical stress on
components, and helps
ensure reliable operation of
the air conditioning system. A
weak or failed capacitor can
result in hard starting,
reduced cooling performance,
increased energy
consumption, or complete
system failure.

lineItems.name: Full System Install Service
lineItems.description:
Our Full System
Installation Service
begins with the careful
disposal of any old

lineItems.name: Signed
lineItems.description:
Paid
equipment to clear
space for your new
system. This
comprehensive service
includes the installation
of both the air handler
and the condenser,
ensuring a seamless and
efficient upgrade to your
HVAC system.
-Air
Handler Installation
We
start by installing the
new air handler,
reconfiguring the
plumbing, and
integrating new float
switches to enhance
safety and prevent
potential water damage.
As part of this process,
we reseal and rebuild
the plenum to optimize
airflow and eliminate air
leaks, maximizing your
system’s efficiency.
Condenser Installation
The installation of the
condenser includes
reconfiguring the line set
to ensure optimal
refrigeration flow. We
clean the line set
thoroughly to remove
any contaminants and
braze in the new system
to establish secure and
durable connections. To
further enhance
performance, we
reinsulate the line set,
ensuring effective
operation and energy
efficiency.
-System
Enhancements and Final
Touches
A new T6
Honeywell thermostat is
installed to give you
precise control over your
system, improving
comfort and energy
efficiency. We also pull a
vacuum to a minimum of
500 microns to eliminate
moisture and air from
the system, ensuring
smooth operation. To
provide added security
and longevity, tamper-
resistant locking caps
are installed on the
refrigerant lines, and
new Hurricane straps are
added to protect the
condenser against
extreme weather
conditions. Once the
installation is complete,
we perform a
comprehensive test of
the entire system to
ensure it operates
smoothly, efficiently, and
reliably, delivering long-
term comfort for your
home or business. This
all-inclusive service
guarantees your new
HVAC system will
provide optimal
performance, safety, and
efficiency for years to
come.
-Preventive
Maintenance Plan
To
keep your new HVAC
system running at peak
performance, we offer a
Preventive Maintenance
Plan. Regular
maintenance helps
extend the life of your
system, improves
efficiency, and reduces
the risk of unexpected
breakdowns. (This plan is
not included please call
our office for more
details on how to sign up
for this plan)

faulty compressor. We then
install a new, manufacturer-
approved compressor,
ensuring all electrical and
refrigerant connections are
secure. After reassembling
the system, we conduct a
thorough leak test, vacuum
the system, and recharge it
with the correct refrigerant.
Finally, we test the system
to ensure proper operation,
efficiency, and reliability, so
your home stays cool and
comfortable.

lineItems.name: Full System Install Service
lineItems.description:
Our Full System Installation
Service begins with the
careful disposal of any old
equipment to clear space
for your new system. This
comprehensive service
includes the installation of
both the air handler and the
condenser, ensuring a
seamless and efficient
upgrade to your HVAC
system.
-Air Handler
Installation
We start by
installing the new air
handler, reconfiguring the
plumbing, and integrating
new float switches to
enhance safety and prevent
potential water damage. As
part of this process, we
reseal and rebuild the
plenum to optimize airflow
and eliminate air leaks,
maximizing your system’s
efficiency.
-Condenser
Installation
The installation
of the condenser includes
reconfiguring the line set to
ensure optimal refrigeration
flow. We clean the line set
thoroughly to remove any
contaminants and braze in
the new system to establish
secure and durable
